Find an Impact person of peace. Explore possibilities

The Impact Movement takes the truth of Jesus Christ
to the campus, community and world by producing
leaders of African descent who are spiritually focused,
financially responsible and morally fit.
Connect the key leader with an Impact coach. Find
out who the Impact team leader is for your region by
clicking here and let them know about the student(s)
that God has brought across your path. They will then
assign an Impact campus coach to establish an on-
going relationship with that student.
The Impact Movement envisions each community
of African descent fulfilling its destiny as a reflection
of the redemptive power of Jesus Christ. We reach
thousands of college students, lead those students
in ministering to the community and expose those
students to God’s work around the world. Our
alumni continue to stay engaged through our Impact
Association. I pray that this web site, our online
resources and the various events we offer will be a
great blessing to you.
Make yourself available to resource the Impact leaders.
In consultation with the Impact coach determine
how you can best serve the Impact students and
where there might be mutual points of connection
with your Cru movement through prayer, evangelistic
opportunities and social events.
To learn more about The Impact Movement, visit the
Impact website and read more about launching an
Impact movement by reading Finding Key Leaders &
Building Impact Movements.
